repos.description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace by Seth Hobson with 83 plugins, 191 agents, 155 skills, 102 commands, and 16 workflow orchestrators. One Markdown source-of-truth generates harness-native artifacts for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI. Uses a tiered model strategy (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) and ships a plugin-eval framework for measuring plugin/skill quality.

Official Anthropic-curated directory of Claude Code plugins. Includes ~36 internal plugins (feature-dev, frontend-design, code-review, code-simplifier, code-modernization, pr-review-toolkit, plugin-dev, agent-sdk-dev, mcp-server-dev, mcp-tunnels, skill-creator, claude-md-management, claude-code-setup, commit-commands, hookify, ralph-loop, session-report, security-guidance, math-olympiad, language-server plugins for Python/TS/Go/Rust/Ruby/Swift/Kotlin/Lua/PHP/C#/clangd/JDT, and a reference example-plugin) plus ~15 third-party external plugins (asana, context7, discord, firebase, github, gitlab, greptile, imessage, laravel-boost, linear, playwright, serena, telegram, terraform, fakechat).

Anthropic's open-source role-based plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork (also compatible with Claude Code). Headline lineup of 11 plugins (productivity, sales, customer-support, product-management, marketing, legal, finance, data, enterprise-search, bio-research, cowork-plugin-management) plus additional plugin folders covering design, engineering, human-resources, operations, small-business, pdf-viewer, and a partner-built directory. Each bundles skills, commands, sub-agents, and MCP connectors for its function.

Every Inc's compound engineering marketplace with two plugins. The compound-engineering plugin (50+ agents, 38+ skills) implements a methodology where each unit of work compounds future productivity — covering strategy, ideation, brainstorming, planning, code review, debugging, optimization, doc review, git workflows, session research, Slack research, and a /ce-setup bootstrap. The coding-tutor plugin pairs three commands with a single tutoring skill. Includes a CLI to convert plugins to 10+ other agent platforms.

Ghost Security's AI-native application security plugin (`ghost`) for Claude Code. Provides 7 skills: ghost-repo-context (business criticality and component mapping), ghost-scan-code (SAST), ghost-scan-deps (SCA exploitability analysis), ghost-scan-secrets (secrets triage), ghost-validate (DAST validation against a live app), ghost-proxy (HTTP proxy for ghost-validate), and ghost-report (combined report across all scans).

An agentic skills framework and software development methodology by Jesse Vincent with 14 composable skills (brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven-development, test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, dispatching-parallel-agents, using-git-worktrees, requesting-code-review, receiving-code-review, verification-before-completion, finishing-a-development-branch, writing-skills, using-superpowers). Enforces a brainstorming → design → planning → subagent-driven development loop with TDD and git worktree isolation. Installable on Claude Code, Codex CLI, Codex App, Factory Droid, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot CLI.

Trail of Bits Claude Code plugin marketplace (~38 plugins) for security research, auditing, and engineering. Categories: smart contract security (building-secure-contracts, entry-point-analyzer), code auditing (audit-context-building, c-review, differential-review, dimensional-analysis, fp-check, insecure-defaults, semgrep-rule-creator/-variant-creator, sharp-edges, static-analysis, supply-chain-risk-auditor, testing-handbook-skills, trailmark, variant-analysis, agentic-actions-auditor, burpsuite-project-parser), verification (constant-time-analysis, mutation-testing, property-based-testing, spec-to-code-compliance, zeroize-audit), reverse engineering (dwarf-expert), malware (yara-authoring), mobile (firebase-apk-scanner), and developer tooling (modern-python, gh-cli, git-cleanup, seatbelt-sandboxer, second-opinion, devcontainer-setup, skill-improver, workflow-skill-design, ask-questions-if-underspecified, claude-in-chrome-troubleshooting, debug-buttercup, culture-index, let-fate-decide). Also exposes a Codex sidecar for Codex-native skill discovery.

Curated, community-vetted Claude Code plugin marketplace maintained by Trail of Bits (~28 plugins). Aggregates and code-reviews third-party skills across development (planning-with-files, python-code-simplifier, react-pdf, skill-extractor), security (ffuf-web-fuzzing, ghidra-headless, scv-scan, security-awareness, wooyun-legacy), research (last30days, x-research), writing (humanizer), and auto-converted OpenAI Codex skills (cloudflare/netlify deploys, gh-address-comments, gh-fix-ci, jupyter-notebook, doc/pdf/spreadsheet, playwright, screenshot, security best-practices/ownership-map/threat-model, sentry, yeet, web-game). Lists other approved marketplaces, and every addition is code-reviewed before inclusion.

Marketing skills for AI coding agents by Corey Haines — 42 skills covering CRO, copywriting, copy-editing, SEO (ai-seo, programmatic-seo, seo-audit, schema, site-architecture), analytics, A/B testing, ads, ad-creative, ASO, churn-prevention, co-marketing, cold-email, community-marketing, competitor-profiling, competitors, content-strategy, customer-research, directory-submissions, emails, free-tools, image, launch, lead-magnets, marketing-ideas, marketing-psychology, onboarding, paywalls, popups, pricing, product-marketing, prospecting, referrals, revops, sales-enablement, signup, sms, social, and video. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Windsurf.

OpenAI's official skills catalog for Codex. Organized into system skills auto-installed with Codex (imagegen, openai-docs, plugin-creator, skill-creator, skill-installer) and ~38 curated skills installable via $skill-installer — Figma design tooling, Notion integrations (knowledge-capture, meeting-intelligence, research-documentation, spec-to-implementation), deployment targets (cloudflare, netlify, render, vercel), GitHub helpers (gh-address-comments, gh-fix-ci, yeet), document handling (pdf, jupyter-notebook), Playwright automation, screenshot/speech/transcribe, security best-practices/ownership-map/threat-model, Sentry, Linear, chatgpt-apps, cli-creator, and migrate-to-codex.

Matt Pocock's reusable agent skills addressing common failure modes in AI-assisted software development (misalignment, verbosity, broken code, architectural decay). Organized into engineering (diagnose, grill-with-docs, improve-codebase-architecture, prototype, setup-matt-pocock-skills, tdd, to-issues, to-prd, triage, zoom-out), productivity (caveman compressed-communication mode, grill-me, handoff, write-a-skill), misc (git-guardrails-claude-code, migrate-to-shoehorn, scaffold-exercises, setup-pre-commit), plus in-progress and personal skill buckets. Distributed via the skills.sh installer for use across Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
